cues.en: Related to perplexity is looking at masked word prediction accuracy.
cues.zh: 與困惑度相關的另一種方法，是查看遮罩字詞預測準確率。

cues.en: The idea is very simple.
cues.zh: 概念很簡單。

cues.en: You start with a sentence or some token sequence, and then mask out a word in the sentence and see whether an LL would predict the missing word.
cues.zh: 先有一句話或詞元序列，遮掉其中一個字，看看 LLM 能否預測缺字。

cues.en: This approach is mainly useful with a Bert type model, because that does not use a causal attention
cues.zh: 主要適合 BERT 類模型，因為它不使用因果注意力

cues.en: mask, which means that these models can use words later in the sequence to predict a missing word earlier in the sequence.
cues.zh: 遮罩，所以能利用序列後面的字，預測前面缺失的字。

cues.en: On the other hand, when I show you the example on the next slide, it will be pretty obvious that even
cues.zh: 但下一張的例子會很明顯，即使

cues.en: when the model is technically incorrect in the sense that it does not predict the actual target word,
cues.zh: 模型沒有預測實際目標詞，技術上算錯，

cues.en: the words that the model does predict can be closely related to the actual target word.
cues.zh: 預測的詞仍可能與目標密切相關。

cues.en: So we as humans probably wouldn't really consider it to be fully incorrect and to measure that semantic relatedness, we will use cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 所以人類也許不會認為完全錯誤。為了衡量語意相關性，會用餘弦相似度。

cues.en: Now, there's not a whole lot of theory or math that you need to understand this code demo that you don't already know.
cues.zh: 這次示範沒有太多你還不知道的理論或數學。

cues.zh: 可以計算模型預測詞元，與句中真實詞元的餘弦相似度，評估相關性。
